note: Online ordering. checkout_url is the address of the checkout worker (see worker/README.md); while it is empty the cart stays hidden. Delivery fees go by straight-line miles from the store to the center of the customer's ZIP code (delivery_zips.json lists every ZIP within the last max_miles). Sales tax applies to the items, not the delivery fee. Products marked ship_free in products.yml can also ship free by UPS to the lower 48 states when everything in the cart is ship_free. Shipped orders are taxed only when the ZIP code is in Iowa (ZIPs starting 500 to 528).
